b.x: No number below is a link. The phone does not dial by itself when you touch the screen. Read, keep the ones that fit, and you call. If the danger is now, do not hunt the perfect number for one more minute. 192 for the body. 190 for violence. 193 for fire and rescue.

These numbers are valid in Brazil. 190, 192, 193, 191, 199, 180, 100, 181, 188, 136 and 0800 722 6001 are Brazilian lines. If you are outside Brazil, the numbers are different. Do not dial 192 in another country expecting SAMU. Do not dial 190 expecting the police there. Before you need it, know the local number of the place you are in. Inside Brazil, 181 is not the same channel in every state. If it does not connect, and the danger is now, go back to 190 or 192.
Snakebite, scorpion, spider, poison, pesticide

192 is SAMU, the medical emergency line. It is the number for this hour. 0800 722 6001 is Anvisa’s poison line: it advises on the poison. It does not replace the ambulance or the antivenom. Antivenom exists only in a health service.
Say snakebite, the time, the town, whether it swells, whether the eyelid drops, whether the urine darkens, whether breath fails. Do not wait for the animal. Do not cut. Do not tourniquet.
Someone taken ill, stroke, heart attack, no breath, fainting, seizure, bleeding
192, SAMU. The ambulance. It is not the number for a small doubt. It is the number for someone who can die in the next hour.
Say where you are, what you see, whether they answer, whether they breathe, the time it started. Do not hang up until they say so.
Robbery, assault, a fight, a threat happening now
190, Military Police. A car. If you cannot speak, leave the line open only if that does not give you away. Do not fight in order to film.
Say the address, what is happening, how many people, whether there is a weapon, whether someone is hurt. If someone is hurt, also 192.
Fire, smoke, gas, a collapse, a person trapped, drowning, a crash with someone in the wreck
193, the fire department. Rescue. If the person is not breathing or is bleeding hard, also call 192.
Say the street, a landmark, whether there is fire, a smell of gas, how many people, whether they are conscious.
A crash or a crime on a federal highway
191, Federal Highway Police. If someone is hurt, 192 does not wait for the highway police. Both.
Say the highway, the kilometer, the direction, how many vehicles, whether someone is hurt or there is fire.
Flood, landslide, a tree, a house at risk
199, Civil Defense. If someone is trapped, in the water, or hurt, 193 and 192 at the same time. Do not wait for 199 to get people out.
Say the neighborhood, whether the water is rising, whether people are inside, whether the house has cracked.
Violence against a woman
180, the women’s hotline. Guidance and the network. If the assault is now, 190 comes first. 180 does not replace the police car.
If you can speak: the address and whether he is still there. If you cannot, 190 with the line open, without an argument.
A child, an older person, or a person with a disability in violence
100, the human-rights hotline. If the danger is this hour, 190. 100 records and refers. It does not arrive instead of emergency help.
Say who is at risk, where, and whether the violence is happening now.
A tip about a crime that is not happening in front of you

181, the anonymous tip line, in much of the country. It is not the number for a robbery happening now. For now, 190. In some states the anonymous line uses another channel. If 181 does not connect, do not insist on it instead of the emergency.
Say the fact, the place, without exposing yourself if you do not have to. Do not go back to the scene to confirm.
An emotional crisis, a wish to die, someone who talks about killing themselves
188, CVV. Emotional support, 24 hours. It is not the police and not the ambulance. If the person is already hurt, is not breathing, or took medicine, 192.
Speak. Stay. Do not leave the person alone while you call. Do not debate whether the pain is real.
A health question that is not an emergency
136, Disque Saúde. Information. It does not send an ambulance. Chest pain, no breath, a snakebite, and fainting are not 136. They are 192.
Use it when the house needs guidance and nobody is collapsing. If someone collapses, switch to 192.
